captions.caption: People are walking on a busy street with cars and trucks parked along the sides of it, including some white vans among them as well.
People are fighting and cars crashing on a busy street, with the camera capturing it all from above as part of an Arabic news broadcast or video leak by Samaa TV.
People are walking on a street with cars and trucks around them, including an ambulance that has stopped to help someone who fell off their motorcycle onto the roadway of traffic near it
